decisions.statement: A rule is weighed before that rule stands.
A command-line rule is weighed alongside the standing rules rather than in place of those rules.
A named rule that does not stand is refused.
The refusal for a named rule lists the rules that do stand.
A run with no rule at all is refused.
The refusal for a run with no rule names the folder the rules are in.
Every rule is weighed against every transaction.

definition: the rules run over the whole history and reported on, writing nothing
